liv (docs): Quick thread to finalize a tiny docs snippet for the Rate & Quota page. Need: a compact JS example that checks quota, a short note about header differences, and a fallback if /quota is unavailable. PR: https://rwd/pulls/5310

sel (sdk): For headers: hosted -> X-Quota-Org, private -> X-Tenant-Quota. Recommend primary: call /quota, fallback to checking headers. I'll drop a 6-line JS sample.

matt (infra): Also call out that panel links are internal; please include a screenshot or use a mock link. Link-checker flags internal grafana URLs.

hana (analytics): Add a one-line troubleshooting callout: "tokens != requests" (embeddings/backfill can consume tokens without request count). Very common.

liv (docs): Draft JS snippet in PR (very small):

```js
client.quota.get().then(q => {
  console.log(q.tokens_left, q.requests_left);
  if (q.requests_left > 0) return client.generate({model: 'rw-medium', prompt: 'ping'});
});
```

sel (sdk): Tiny edits: use snake_case field names as shown, and avoid ignoring promise errors in examples. I'll push an update with .catch().

liv (docs): For fallback example, I'll add one line: check response headers: header = res.headers['x-quota-org'] || res.headers['x-tenant-quota']

matt (infra): I'll attach a sanitized PNG to the PR instead of an internal grafana link. link-bot will still warn but CI will pass.

hana (analytics): +1 on the troubleshooting line. Also suggest a one-sentence explanatory blurb about burst credits (illustrative only): multi-tenant uses per-org burst; dedicated uses pool-level burst.

link-bot: link-check: https://grafana/internal/consumption returned 403. Suggest screenshot artifact or public mock.

liv (docs): Thanks all 700. Please react with :white_check_mark: on PR once you see the pushed fixes and image. I'll merge after CI green.

sel (sdk): :white_check_mark:

hana (analytics): :white_check_mark:

matt (infra): :white_check_mark:

link-bot: CI: link-check queued.
